//: Runtime component manifest -- see src-tauri/src/runtime_fetch.rs and docs/RUNTIME-PACKS.md.
//2: Compiled in as the baseline. A hosted copy at `manifest_url` overrides it at runtime, so component URLs/versions can move without an app release.
//3: sha256/size/version are filled in by CI (scripts/pack-components.mjs) per platform. An empty sha256 means 'not yet published': the downloader refuses it unless REELS_CAPTION_APP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_COMPONENTS=1 (local testing only).
//4: One entry per (id, platform). runtime_fetch.rs filters to the current host; a platform with no entries behaves like the pre-pack slim build (features that need a runtime error until packs exist). Only windows-x64 is listed here; the release CI's mac/linux legs append macos-arm64 / macos-x64 / linux-x64 entries.
//5: unpack_to is relative to ~/.reels-caption-app/runtime/. An archive's contents extract directly into that dir; archives may carry leaf dirs (python-voice carries python/tts|media-ai|voice-clone/ and tts-models/en/).
